ownership.businessAuthority: Mobile merchant session bridge that re-signs identity lb_session tokens into gateway-accepted internal session headers without owning commerce business logic.

observabilityAuthority.audit: gateway-owned merchant mutations emit canonical audit events

executionAuthority.executionRole: Execution container for mobile auth transport and gateway proxying only.
executionAuthority.orchestrationRole: No business orchestration; delegates all route behavior to services/api-gateway and package-owned contracts.
executionAuthority.infrastructureOwnership: May wire Cloudflare service binding and internal auth secret; no provider SDK ownership.
executionAuthority.eventOwnership: No durable event ownership; forwards correlation metadata to the gateway.
executionAuthority.queryOwnership: No read-model ownership; forwards gateway responses only.
executionAuthority.compositionOwnership: Composes transport headers and response streaming only.

orchestrationAuthority: Transport and gateway invocation only; business orchestration delegates to services/api-gateway and application-services.
eventAuthority: No durable event authority; event persistence and dispatch remain in services/api-gateway, services/queue-workers, and package contracts.
workflowAuthority: No workflow authority; workflows, use cases, sequencing, and cross-domain coordination are owned by application-services.
queryAuthority: No query assembly authority; service-side reads delegate to services/api-gateway and runtime-composition contracts.
compositionAuthority: Owns mobile transport composition only: session extraction, internal header signing, and gateway proxy response forwarding.
executionOwnership: Execution container for mobile BFF APIs, runtime bootstrapping, transport signing, and gateway service binding only.
distributedExecutionOwnership: No durable distributed execution ownership; durable queues, checkpoints, replay, and coordination delegate to services/api-gateway, services/queue-workers, and service runtime governance contracts.
queueOwnership: No queue execution ownership; queue production and consumption delegate to services/api-gateway and services/queue-workers.
providerOwnership: None; provider execution must go through services/api-gateway or packages/infrastructure adapters behind service API boundaries.
executionBoundaries: Execution-container boundary: mobile session transport, header signing, gateway proxying, health, and runtime bootstrapping only.
asyncExecutionOwnership: No durable async ownership; async workflows, queues, replay, and retries delegate to services and orchestration runtimes.
observabilityOwnership: Propagates request, correlation, and trace metadata across the BFF to gateway boundary.
telemetryOwnership: Owns execution-container telemetry emission for BFF requests while durable telemetry pipelines delegate to service runtimes.
workflowRecoveryOwnership: No workflow recovery ownership; recovery policy delegates to application-services and service-local event helpers through service APIs.
recoveryOwnership: No runtime recovery ownership beyond deploy rollback; workflow, replay, queue, and projection recovery delegate to service runtimes.
replayOwnership: No replay ownership; replay lifecycle delegates to service execution containers and service-local event helpers.
checkpointOwnership: No checkpoint ownership; checkpoints delegate to service runtimes using service runtime governance contracts and runtime-composition.
projectionOwnership: No local projection policy ownership; projections and read models use services/api-gateway and packages/runtime-composition.
cqrsOwnership: No CQRS command or projection persistence ownership; command sequencing delegates to services/api-gateway and application-services.
cacheOwnership: No durable cache coordination ownership; cache policy delegates to runtime-composition, runtime-composition, and service runtimes.
coordinationOwnership: No distributed coordination ownership; leases, locks, fencing tokens, heartbeats, and leader election delegate to service runtimes using service runtime governance contracts.
resilienceOwnership: Owns only BFF transport fail-closed behavior; provider retries, circuit breakers, and fallback execution delegate to service runtimes.
regionalOwnership: Owns Cloudflare edge deployment metadata for mobile BFF transport while global routing contracts delegate to service runtime governance contracts.
tenantScalingOwnership: No tenant workload governance ownership; quotas, partitioning, noisy-neighbor protection, and runtime metrics delegate to service execution containers.
auditOwnership: No business audit ownership; privileged actions and durable audit trails are emitted by services/api-gateway.
operationalOwnership: Owns BFF health, diagnostics, deployment topology participation, and operational readiness for the mobile auth bridge.
telemetryExecutionOwnership: Owns BFF request telemetry emission for traces, metrics, structured logs, and correlation propagation.
replayExecutionOwnership: No replay execution ownership; replay scheduling, authorization, dry-runs, and rollback coordination delegate to service execution containers.
queueExecutionOwnership: No queue execution ownership; queue inspection, recovery, redrive, retry, and dead-letter operations delegate to queue worker and API service runtimes.
resilienceExecutionOwnership: Owns fail-closed transport checks for missing signing secrets; broader resilience execution delegates to service runtimes.
regionalExecutionOwnership: Owns region-aware Cloudflare deployment metadata for BFF transport; tenant affinity and failover execution delegate to service runtimes.
auditExecutionOwnership: No audit execution ownership; runtime audit persistence and operational security telemetry delegate to backend service runtimes.
cacheExecutionOwnership: No cache execution ownership; cache invalidation and lifecycle metrics delegate to runtime-composition, runtime-composition, and service runtimes.
coordinationExecutionOwnership: No distributed coordination execution ownership; worker leases, fencing tokens, leader election, and ownership transfer delegate to service runtimes.
diagnosticsOwnership: Owns user-safe BFF health diagnostics only; runtime diagnostics persistence and incident metadata delegate to operational service runtimes.
operationalControlPlaneOwnership: No operational control-plane ownership; replay, workflow, queue, resilience, telemetry, tenant, and recovery commands delegate to platform service runtimes.
deploymentOwnership: Owns production deployment wiring for Mobile BFF; provider manifests are declared in runtime topology and service deployment config.
observabilityInfrastructureOwnership: Emits correlated runtime telemetry to the OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Tempo, Loki, and Grafana stack declared in infrastructure/observability.
queueProviderOwnership: Delegates production queue provider execution to services/api-gateway producers and services/queue-workers consumers.
eventStoreOwnership: Delegates event persistence to service runtime governance contracts contracts backed by Supabase Postgres append-only event store.
failoverOwnership: Participates in active/passive failover through Cloudflare deployment topology and service-owned runtime fallback.
incidentOwnership: Participates in incident metadata, diagnostics, alert routing, and audit records through production incident governance.
deploymentTopologyOwnership: Must match config/runtime/deployment-topology.json and config/runtime/production-topology.json; topology drift is a hard validation failure.
securityOwnership: Owns mobile BFF secret binding, fail-closed internal session signing, and no-secret client boundary enforcement.
chaosOwnership: Participates in approved chaos experiments recorded in chaos_experiment_runs with guardrails and rollback commands.
loadTestingOwnership: Participates in k6/Gatling/Locust production-readiness benchmarks recorded in load_test_runs.
controlPlaneOwnership: Uses operator UI/API surfaces for control-plane visibility and delegates execution to service runtimes.
regionalRoutingOwnership: Uses Cloudflare global-edge routing and delegates stateful regional execution to service and data runtimes.
productionOwnership: Owns production execution-container readiness, deployment health, runtime diagnostics, and operational recovery for the mobile auth bridge.
deploymentPipelineOwnership: Owns deployment pipeline gates through infrastructure/deployment, production-rollout workflow, health gates, rollback runbooks, and production topology validation.
telemetryInfrastructureOwnership: Owns telemetry infrastructure integration through OpenTelemetry, runtime telemetry tables, Prometheus alerts, and dashboard projections.
dashboardOwnership: Delegates operational dashboard projection exposure through platform-console operations UI and Grafana dashboards without local mock data.
operationalDashboardOwnership: Delegates operational dashboard projection exposure through platform-console operations UI and Grafana dashboards without local mock data.
sreOwnership: Owns SRE participation for mobile BFF SLOs, error budgets, escalation paths, readiness scoring, and incident runbook participation.
replayOperationsOwnership: Delegates replay execution, authorization, checkpointing, and recovery to services/event-bus, services/api-gateway, and distributed-runtime packages.
